primaryChecks.text: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は「the River」とだけ記し、ユーフラテスと直接名指ししていない。

primaryChecks.text: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
primaryChecks.nextContext: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:9 はEuphratesを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 18:3 はEuphratesを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「beyond the River」は文脈上ユーフラテスを指す可能性が高いが本文に固有名はなく、本文の地理句としてのみ保留しこのカードの直接採用から除外。
